items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I remember there was a drummer by the name of Freddie Green... I couldn't tell you the name of the bands.

ctx.x: Oh, golly, I don't know. I remember there was a drummer by the name of Freddie Green, who did everything that Lionel did, you know. I think he'd been watching him pretty closely, and throwing the sticks around, and I remember he was in one of the bands. But I couldn't tell you the name of the bands. We used to get together with a lot of the musicians and have jam sessions, particularly in the -- there was a place there, I think it was called Green's, it was a little restaurant, a little nothing restaurant, you…
